product_overview: Remon Download is a desktop download manager for YouTube videos, Shorts, playlists, and related media. It helps a single local user analyze YouTube links, manage download activity, schedule jobs, and configure app preferences without requiring sign-in.
core_goals: Navigate between the main app sections without authentication
Analyze a YouTube URL and add valid videos to the download queue
Manage queued downloads by pausing, resuming, canceling, retrying, and reordering items
Review past downloads and promote useful items to favorites or re-download them
Create and cancel scheduled downloads for a chosen date, time, and repeat pattern
Customize app behavior through settings such as language, theme, quality, formats, folder, and filename template
View application information and contact details on the About page

features.name: Primary Navigation
features.description: Move between the app’s main pages from the sidebar without signing in.
user_flows: Navigate to /#/ -> Open Dashboard, Queue, History, Favorites, Scheduler, Settings, and About from the sidebar -> Land on the selected page

features.name: Quick Add URL Analysis
features.description: Paste a YouTube link, validate it, inspect the detected media details, choose download options, and add it to the queue.
user_flows: Navigate to /#/ -> Enter a valid YouTube URL -> Start analysis -> Review the detected video information -> Choose quality and format -> Add the video to the queue
Navigate to /#/ -> Enter an invalid YouTube URL -> Start analysis -> See a validation error and no item is added to the queue
Navigate to /#/ -> Enter a playlist URL -> Start analysis -> Select specific videos from the results -> Add the selected videos to the queue
Navigate to /#/ -> Enter a channel URL -> Start analysis -> See a notice that channel-wide downloading is not supported

features.name: Download Queue Management
features.description: Monitor queued downloads and control their order and execution state.
user_flows: Navigate to /#/queue -> View the queue items and their download status
Navigate to /#/queue -> Adjust the concurrent download setting -> Update how many items can download at once
Navigate to /#/queue -> Adjust the speed limit setting -> Update the maximum download rate
Navigate to /#/queue -> Pause an active download -> See it stop progressing
Navigate to /#/queue -> Resume a paused download -> See it continue
Navigate to /#/queue -> Cancel a download -> Remove it from active processing
Navigate to /#/queue -> Retry a failed download -> Send it back into the queue
Navigate to /#/queue -> Drag an item to a new position -> Reorder the queue
Navigate to /#/queue -> Open the download folder when available -> View the saved files location
Navigate to /#/queue -> View the empty queue state -> See that no downloads are currently queued

features.name: Download History
features.description: Review completed, failed, and canceled downloads and act on past items.
user_flows: Navigate to /#/history -> View completed, failed, and canceled download entries
Navigate to /#/history -> Retry a history item -> Add it back to the download flow
Navigate to /#/history -> Mark a history item as favorite -> Save it to Favorites
Navigate to /#/history -> Delete a history item -> Remove it from history
Navigate to /#/history -> Open the containing folder when available -> View the file location
Navigate to /#/history -> View the empty history state -> See that no past downloads are stored

features.name: Favorites
features.description: Keep selected videos in a saved list and send them back to the queue when needed.
user_flows: Navigate to /#/favorites -> View the saved favorites list
Navigate to /#/favorites -> Add a favorite back to the queue -> Start downloading it again
Navigate to /#/favorites -> Remove a favorite -> Delete it from the saved list
Navigate to /#/favorites -> View the empty favorites state -> See that no favorites are saved

features.name: Scheduler
features.description: Schedule a download for a future time and optionally repeat it later.
user_flows: Navigate to /#/scheduler -> Enter a URL, date, time, and repeat option -> Submit the scheduled download -> Save the job for later execution
Navigate to /#/scheduler -> Enter invalid scheduling input -> Submit the form -> See validation errors and keep the job unscheduled
Navigate to /#/scheduler -> Cancel a scheduled item -> Remove the pending job
Navigate to /#/scheduler -> Wait for a scheduled job to trigger -> Be taken to the queue after it starts

features.name: Settings
features.description: Adjust application preferences such as language, theme, download defaults, and filename behavior.
user_flows: Navigate to /#/settings -> Change the language -> See the interface update in the chosen language
Navigate to /#/settings -> Toggle between dark and light theme -> See the visual theme change
Navigate to /#/settings -> Change the default quality and formats -> Update download defaults
Navigate to /#/settings -> Change concurrent downloads and speed limit -> Update download performance preferences
Navigate to /#/settings -> Edit the filename template -> Review the generated filename preview
Navigate to /#/settings -> Select a download folder -> Choose where files are saved
Navigate to /#/settings -> Reset settings and confirm -> Restore default preferences

features.name: About
features.description: Show application identity and contact information for the desktop app.
user_flows: Navigate to /#/about -> Read the application name and version -> View developer information and contact links
Navigate to /#/about -> Open an email, phone, or WhatsApp contact link -> Launch the chosen contact method

routes.description: Dashboard Quick Add page to paste a YouTube URL, analyze metadata, and add videos to the download queue
Download queue with status, pause/resume/cancel/retry, reorder, concurrent download and speed limit controls
History of completed, failed, and canceled downloads with retry, favorite, delete, and open-folder actions
Saved favorite videos with download-again and remove actions
Schedule downloads for a future date/time with repeat options
App settings for language, theme, download folder, quality, formats, concurrency, speed limit, and filename template
About page with app name, version, developer info, and contact links

known_limitations.issue: App uses HashRouter, so browser URLs are hash-based (/#/queue) rather than path-based
known_limitations.impact: Tests must navigate hash routes, not /queue path-only URLs

known_limitations.issue: Native download, folder picker, and tray features require Electron; Vite-only browser mode uses mocks/simulation
known_limitations.impact: Folder picker may show unavailable toast; real yt-dlp downloads will not run in browser-only TestSprite sessions
Analyzing a channel URL shows a notice instead of queueing the whole channel
